items.raw_desc: Baba ülőke Ingenuity 2in1 Baby Base Night Sky 2in1 ülőke:The comfortable, easy-to-clean seat cushion helps your child eat at the table at the ideal height. Enjoy more laughter and conversation, including children's conversations, when having lunch or dinner together. The seat cushion is easy to attach to dining chairs. The 2-in-1 function allows you to use it as a seat at the table, but also as a seat on the floor during leisure time. Thanks to the removable counter, baby has his own table of the perfect size where snacks and toys are within reach. When not in use, it conveniently flips out from under the seat itself. When your child outgrows the high chair this booster seat is just what you need.     Key features of the Ingenuity child seatEasily attaches to dining chairs2-in-1 function as table or floor seat Option to attach a backrest for smaller childrenEasy to cleanRemovable BPA-free counterRemovable foam insertRecommended age:From 6 monthsWearability:Using a foam insert max. 15 kg, without foam insert max. 22 kgProduct dimensions:30 × 44 × 39 cm
